question: How does repetition lead to the supreme Shiva called Bhairava?
premises: One reaches the supreme Shiva known as Bhairava even through repetition.
True repetition is of the same nature as that reality.
Such repetition has fallen away from the states of being and nonbeing.
inference: Repetition becomes effective when it transcends duality and aligns with the very nature of Bhairava.
plain_english: One reaches the supreme Shiva, called Bhairava, even through repetition; but true repetition is of that very nature, having fallen away from the states of being and nonbeing.
